subject: Locking a 30‑min Quick Look — availability for core team & infra

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Locking a 30‑min Quick Look — availability for core team & infra

Hi Samira — thanks again for the call this morning. Good to hear more about Atlas Health’s plans for triaging clinical notes and the constraints you’re tracking on latency and data residency. Quick recap and a couple of calendar asks so we can get the next step on the books: 

Recap (2 lines):
- Main goal: evaluate Redwood Inference as the inference runtime for in‑prod clinical summarization (low latency, private VPC).
- Primary stakeholders: you (product), James (security), and an infra/ops lead to validate network and KMS requirements.

Proposed next step: a 30‑minute Quick Look (product demo + infra Q&A). I can present a concise walkthrough focused on throughput/latency tradeoffs, deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and expected unit economics.

Please pick whichever of the following works best for your core team (all times PST):
- Option A: Tue Dec 21, 10:00–10:30 AM PST
- Option B: Tue Dec 21, 2:00–2:30 PM PST
- Option C: Wed Dec 22, 9:00–9:30 AM PST

Attachments: redwood-quicklook-agenda.pdf (2‑slide agenda) and SOC2-one-pager.pdf (high level).

Who should I invite from Atlas (security contact + infra owner)? If you confirm a slot and attendees I’ll circulate a calendar invite and a brief pre‑call checklist.

Thanks — Ben

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0182

Thanks Samira — looping James and Priya. 

James / Priya — nice to meet you via email. I’ve attached a 2‑slide agenda and a SOC2 one‑pager; during the 30‑minute Quick Look I’ll:
- 10m: product highlights and a very short live demo (generation + latency profile)
- 10m: infra & security Q&A (networking, KMS, audit logs)
- 10m: next steps, pricing sketch, and rollout options (hosted → dedicated → private)

Given the team asks I’ll prepare one slide with a sample token cost / latency table at the 95th percentile for a 1.2k token prompt and highlight what changes with batching/quantization.

To make this concrete I created two confirmed slots — please pick one by replying here or accept the calendar link below: 
- Confirmed Slot 1: Tue Dec 21, 2:00–2:30 PM PST (preferred) — calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/ben/atlas-quicklook?slot=2
- Backup Slot 2: Wed Dec 22, 9:00–9:30 AM PST — calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/ben/atlas-quicklook?slot=3

If we get a quick accept I’ll include a short pre‑call checklist (test access, sample prompt, list of attendees) and share the meeting notes afterward.

See you soon — Ben
